section: Perspectives in Education · Ch4 — Teaching Methods (Complete)
subject: Perspectives in Education
stem: Before teaching a single class period, a teacher prepares a detailed written outline covering the specific objectives, teaching aids, step-by-step activities, and evaluation questions for that one period. This detailed, day-to-day teaching outline is called a:
explanation: A lesson plan is a detailed outline for a SINGLE class period, while a unit plan covers several related lessons over multiple periods.

section: Perspectives in Education · Ch4 — Teaching Methods (Complete)
subject: Perspectives in Education
stem: A teacher prepares a broader plan covering several related lessons on the topic 'Photosynthesis' spread across two weeks, sequencing sub-topics logically before breaking them into individual day-to-day lesson plans. This broader plan is called a:
explanation: A unit plan covers a related group of lessons on one topic across multiple periods, broader than a single lesson plan but narrower than the full annual syllabus.
